nodes.name: Read Target List (Google Sheet)
nodes.notes: Sheet columns: name, company, role, profileUrl, status (blank = not contacted), jobReqId

values.content: You draft short, warm, NON-spammy LinkedIn connection notes (max 280 chars) and a follow-up message asking for a referral. You are writing on behalf of Nikunj Goyal: ex-Adobe MTS-2 (Illustrator, 5 patents, 2 KubeCon talks), IIT Roorkee applied math, now exploring roles. Be specific, human, never use the words 'synergy' or 'I hope this finds you well'. Reference the recipient's company and the role honestly. Output JSON: {connectionNote, followUp}.
Recipient: {{ $json.name }}, {{ $json.role }} at {{ $json.company }}. Target job req: {{ $json.jobReqId }}. Draft a connection note and a follow-up referral ask.

nodes.notes: HUMAN-IN-THE-LOOP GATE. The drafts land in your own Slack/DM. You copy-paste and send by hand. No automated LinkedIn actions = no ToS violation, no ban risk.
